title: To the Holy Spring
overview: After winning the magic duel with Yu Ang, Mo Fan is granted the right to train in the Underground Holy Spring. However, something strange is happening at the spring.

title: Blood Color Alert
overview: Whilst Mo Fan is training at the Underground Holy Spring, many strong monsters invade the city.

title: Breakout
overview: The "Black Vatican" has Summoned monsters which run amok in the city, killing many. The mages do what they can.

title: Life and Death the Three Kilometers Walk
overview: The Magic High-School students decide that they need to escape from the high school and get to the safe zone, but it will be risky. Meanwhile Mo-Fan has to escape from the Underground Holy Spring.

title: Instructor Bai Yang
overview: The Magic High-School students battle with the monsters as they try to flee to the safe zone.

title: Trapped Heart Summer
overview: The students continue their battle towards the safe zone, with continuing monster attacks. The injured need to be treated and they are confronted by a traitor from the army.

title: The Face of the Black Vatican
overview: The traitor wants the Underground Hold Spring that Mo Fan is carrying, but Mo Fan tries to outsmart him.

title: Hard Fight Against the Black Sheep Demon
overview: The students arrive at the safe zone, but Mo Fan is in trouble for the way he protected the UHS from the traitor.

title: Healing
overview: Mo Fan meets with the army and the city monster hunters as they try to decide how to protect the city.

title: Post-disaster Bo City
overview: The City Monster Hunters, including Mo Fan, head back into the city to try and cut off the monster's entry route into the city.

title: Play the Town of Strange Things
overview: Mo Fan is separated from the monster hunters. He finds his sister under attack from monsters and has to figure out how to rescue her.

title: Fire Magic of Spiritual Species
overview: Mo Fan and his sister head over to help the City Monster Hunter Team close the tunnels that are letting the monsters into the city. Meanwhile, the General and his team take on the Winged Wolf.
